physicalTurns.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. A production pixel-art animation for the EXACT same approved stocky brown tabby cat. Images 1-3 are neutral front, left profile, rear anatomy masters; image4 is original approved identity. Preserve exact fine pixel texture, warm brown palette, forehead M, olive-gold eyes, broad short face, cream muzzle and chest, dark mackerel stripes, thick ringed hooked tail, robust body, FOUR anatomical legs only. Do not redesign or simplify. Render NINE genuinely different motion cels in a strict 3 columns x3 rows grid, one full-body cat per cell, transparent PNG, requested canvas1402x1122, eachcell approximately467x374. No labels, grid lines, ground, shadows, accessories, or copied ghost limbs. Same camera and pixel scale, feet reference ground near localy360, body centered roughlyx233. Padding around ears and tail; never clip. Every row-major cel is part of ONE real cat taking little steps to turn. Crucial: THIS IS NOT A ROTATING MODEL SHEET. Do NOT rigidly rotate a standing cat with all paws glued down. Head leads first, flexible spine bends, shoulders follow, hips turn LAST, one actual paw lifts away from its former ground position and visibly plants elsewhere, then the next paw follows. The tail trails the body with slight lag. Keep the other support paws anchored. No circular platform, no sliding paws, no entire body rigid yaw between evenly-spaced angles. Four legs connected anatomically, only one swinging limb at a time, never leave a duplicate stationary paw where the lifted paw came from. Show a short weight transfer before each step, with elbow or hock bending. The motion must read as a living animal turning itself, not a camera orbit. Action: turn from front-facing standing to back-facing standing by stepping toward screen-left. Frame1 exact neutral FRONT stance. Frame2 head looks left about40degrees WHILE chest and hips still front, slight neck bend; allfour support paws still planted. Frame5 secondforepaw lifts andsteps around behindfirst, headnearlyleftprofile, shouldersabout100degrees, hipsstillabout50degrees; spine curves gently. Frame6 nearhindpaw visiblyliftswithhockflexed tofollowshoulders, shouldersabout140degrees, hipsabout95degrees, weightonotherhindpawandforefeet. Frame7 thathindpaw lands; oppositehindpaw liftsandmakeslastsmallstep, shouldersnearlyrear, hipsabout145degrees. Frame8 lastpawlands, pelvisfinishesfollowingtorso, headalreadyfacesaway, tailsettles. Frame9 exact neutral REAR standing master, backofheadandfurryouterears visible, no face. Head and torso must NOT rotate in lockstep.
